security.method: Exact original provider-secret matching in UTF-8 and UTF-16, including streamed GZIP WebGL payloads

limitations: The retained multiplayer chat launcher has no local chat panel in the isolated module; its external multiplayer integration is not accepted.
Preserves original story data and native gameplay with approved generated minigame art; this is not acceptance of every optional/alternate branch or every external service.
The recorded run reaches the original MeetingCells-to-Heart handoff, not a playable external Heart scene.
Live same-origin, signed-in PING outfit synchronization is not verified; canonical outfit and account-boundary tests are separate.
Peer-agent service status is recorded above. An unavailable/rate-limited service follows the original fallback; no local invented grading is used.
Original White win progression also has a separate physics-focused Unity test. That fixture is not evidence of a browser-input win unless this run actually records one.

The full route is hybrid: keyboard/mouse world navigation and original timed activities, actual native joystick touch/end/cancel checks, then phone worksheet touch and browser-keyboard typing. This is not a pure-touch full journey or physical soft-keyboard acceptance.

Mobile touch input, portrait/landscape layouts and high-DPR targets are checked in Chromium emulation; physical devices, Safari, heat/battery behavior, physical gamepads and human difficulty review remain outside this acceptance scope.
Warnings, narrowly recognized touchcancel browser interventions and known Chromium loader cancellations remain visible in the reports. They are not erased or called successful network requests.
